title: Aurora Forge WWE 2K26 PC Modding Fact Library
policy: Confirmed facts require a primary tool-maker or official project source. Community demonstrations are useful examples but remain version-sensitive.

facts.fact: The CakeHook package documented for WWE 2K26 is installed by placing its dinput8 file and Plugins folder in the WWE 2K26 directory.
CakeView 26 documents WWE 2K20-2K26 file support, baking, file exploration, a shader-enabled model viewer, MTLS viewing, directory watching, silent baking, and an Always Alive CAK fast-bake function.
Tribute 26's initial announcement described 732 new character slots, 25 attire slots per character, 2500 custom music slots, 2500 ring-announcer slots, and Auto-Bake communication with CakeView.
Tribute 26 v1.3.0 announced game-save editing, advanced entrance profiles, and additional audio slots for belts, teams, hometowns, entrance voiceovers, moves, taunts, and props.
Microsoft DirectXTex texconv can read DDS, read and write WIC formats including PNG, select a DXGI output format, create mipmaps, recurse through folders, and write to an output directory.
A replacement DDS should match the working target texture's dimensions, compression/DXGI format, alpha expectations, and mip behavior instead of using one universal preset.
Multiple WWE 2K26 community tutorials demonstrate current custom-theme workflows using SoundFactory; exact audio conversion and ID steps must be checked against the current SoundFactory release.

MCD, MTLS, JMTL, and YCL files can expose readable names or references, but readable strings do not prove that direct binary editing is safe. Aurora Forge keeps inspection read-only unless a supported editor workflow is documented.

unknowns: A complete public specification for WWE 2K26 MCD, MTLS, JMTL, and YCL binary formats was not located.
Exact model import/export rules can vary with CakeView and the PWM Blender add-on version.
Exact custom-audio codec, container, and slot steps can vary with SoundFactory releases.
A game or tool update can invalidate addresses, plugins, file layouts, IDs, or automation behavior.
